other_conditions: Must be a resident of West Bengal
Must be between 18 and 60 years of age
Family income should not exceed ₹6,500 per month, except for construction and transport workers where there is no income limit
Income calculation is based on the average family income over the 12 months prior to the application
Applicant must belong to the unorganized sector as defined under Part A or Part B of the West Bengal Unorganized Sector Workers Welfare Act, 2007
benefits_summary: Provides a provident fund, health and surgical expense coverage, death/disability compensation, and education assistance to eligible unorganized workers and their families.
